name: Rustic furniture designs LLC
old_description: We’re grateful for every family that invites our work into their home.
about:
Rustic Furniture Designs LLC operates from Orrville, Ohio, where it produces handcrafted solid wood furniture for residential customers. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, and no founders are named on its website.

The shop builds a range of indoor furniture including dining tables, chairs, barstools, coffee tables, end tables, sofa tables, TV stands, storage pantries, wall shelves, charcuterie boards, and specialty racks. All pieces are described as solid wood with no veneers or particle board, and the company invites custom work requests. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

The primary customer base is families furnishing their homes, with products marketed as heirloom-quality items built for generations. The catalog spans farmhouse, midcentury, and modern collections, suggesting appeal to a variety of interior design preferences.

The company emphasizes durability and material honesty as its differentiators: every piece is handcrafted from solid wood, free of veneers or particle board, and positioned as artisan work meant to last. This focus on traditional joinery and solid lumber is presented as the core reason the business exists.
